name: The Black Morass, a historical memory
shortDescription: The Black Morass, a historical memory, a named setting in the Karazhan research story.
body: The associated original environment art preserves these Historical memory of the swamp at the Opening of the Dark Portal: drowned trees, mud flats, green-brown haze and the dark portal. Clearly label this as a past scene, not a current route. It remains an interpretive scene; no exact route, dungeon layout or surveyed coordinate is asserted.
